Subject: BrightPath - Mutual Action Plan / evaluation plan (next steps)

Hi Alicia / Ben —

Great to meet you both on today's call. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment while you share internally: 

Summary of discovery:
- Primary goal: validate Redwood inference for real-time summarization and cost reduction across BrightPath's inference workload (customer-facing pipelines).
- Success metrics: latency <= 180ms p95, 30% token cost reduction vs current baseline, no regression in summary quality on sample set.
- Key constraints: data residency for logs, SOC2 evidence required, evaluation must run in a VPC (Dedicated or Private).

Proposed evaluation / Mutual Action Plan (attached): brightpath_map_v1.xlsx
- Owner: please confirm who on your side will own evaluation (PO / Eng) and who will be the operational lead for infra/security.
- Timeline: target 4-week evaluation. Suggested milestones in the MAP:
  1) Week 0: contract & environment setup (account provisioning, KMS config)
  2) Week 1: smoke tests + latency profiling
  3) Week 2: end-to-end sample run + quality checks
  4) Week 3: cost profiling and optimization recommendations
  5) Week 4: final review and decisioning

Can you confirm owners and tentative start date? If it helps, Rishi (cc'd) can coordinate environment setup and Monica will own onboarding/checklist items from a CS perspective.

Next steps from my side:
- I will share the MAP (attached) and a short onboarding checklist with links to the private deployment guide.
- If you prefer, we can lock a 15-min call next week to walk through the MAP with the stakeholders.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning on owners/dates so we can reserve Dedicated capacity if needed.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
